summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of ProductPulse AI PWA. Backend APIs working correctly (96.2% pass rate). Frontend fully functional on desktop and mobile with AI analysis, product health tracking, recommendations, alerts, and settings all operational. PWA features (manifest, service worker, offline support) verified.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 422 instead of 400 for missing required fields
minor_issues.impact: Minor - FastAPI uses 422 for validation errors by convention, not a real bug
